recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take with or without food
single_dose: 50 mg || 100 mg (immediate release) || 100 mg, 150 mg, 200 mg, and 300 mg (extended release)
mechanism_of_action: blocks the pain signals communicated between the neurotransmitters and the brain
side_effects: stomach problems like constipation or diarrhea
unsuitable_population: pregnant women, breastfeeding women, persons with severe asthma or breathing problems, blockages in the stomach, recently used sedatives, including alcohol, prone to seizures or at risk
